summary: Establish temporary seat pool and onboard DataStitch (SCIM + SSO) for Analytics pilot
description:
Issue summary:
Request to provision a temporary pool of 30 DataStitch seats for a 6-week analytics pilot across Research and Growth teams, plus full SCIM provisioning and Okta SSO mapping.

Background:
DataStitch is a vendor recommended by the Growth analytics lead for cohort analysis during Q1 experiments. The pilot requires fast onboarding (start of week 9) and a billing attribution to cost center ENG-RD-103. The vendor supports SCIM and SAML SSO; security team requested attestation and minimal data access scope.

Impact:
Without seats and automated provisioning, engineers will spend time on manual invites and seat management, delaying experiment launch. No customer data is required for the initial pilot but access will include internal product dashboards and aggregated event exports.

Request details:
- Procure 30 temporary user seats for DataStitch (6 weeks, auto-expire).
- Configure SCIM provisioning from Okta (map default groups: research, growth-analysts).
- Configure SAML SSO domain redwood.ai with IdP metadata.
- Billing: attribute to ENG-RD-103 and set invoice routing to Procurement mailbox.
- Security: collect completed vendor security questionnaire and SOC2-lite evidence; restrict export destinations to approved buckets.

Acceptance criteria:
- 30 seats provisioned and visible in seat inventory.
- SCIM automation successfully creates users when Okta group assigned and deprovisions after 6 weeks.
- SSO login tested with two pilot users (one research, one growth).
- Billing code applied on invoice or invoice metadata.
- Security sign-off documented on Confluence.

Timeline:
- Requested start: 2026-02-23
- Target pilot kickoff: 2026-03-02

Budget owner: "Research Platform (ENG-RD)"

Notes for assignee:
Please coordinate with Security (tagged) before provisioning SCIM. If vendor cannot support group-scoped SCIM or expiry, request a manual seat expiration policy documented in Confluence.
